description: Data coverage report for countries: which reference prices, real labor rates, catalog products (with links) and store prices exist in the database, what is missing or stale. Use it to decide what to look up and save (save_catalog_items, save_prices, save_labor_rates) — e.g. when asked to fill the database for a country. Without country — a short summary for all countries.
